title: Pressure loss or hull breach
reference: NASA ISS Emergency Flight Rules: Cabin Depressurization, Emergency Ingress & Decompression Sickness (DCS) Management.

q1.text: Is an automated cabin depressurization alarm sounding or is vehicle pressure dropping rapidly below 14.7 psi (760 mmHg)?

i_pba.text: DON EMERGENCY OXYGEN IMMEDIATELY: Put on Portable Breathing Apparatus (PBA) or launch/entry pressure suits set to 100% O2 to prevent hypoxia and acute decompression sickness.

q2.text: Is the leak localized to a specific module, and is the ultrasonic/acoustic leak detector identifying the breach point?

i_patch.text: ISOLATE AND PATCH: Evacuate the breached module. Close and latch the pressure hatch. If safe and breach is identified, apply emergency flexible hull patch clamp over breach.

t_patch.text: Verify pressure stabilization over 3 minutes while monitoring module delta-P pressure transducer.

q_pressure_stable.text: Has the vehicle cabin pressure stabilized following hatch closure and patch application?

end_contained.text: PRESSURE STABILIZED: Module isolated successfully. Monitor bulkhead pressure differential gauges and conduct structural telemetry inspection.

end_catastrophic.text: LEAK UNCONTAINED: Initiate emergency capsule ingress procedures and prepare for emergency undocking sequence.

i_safe_haven.text: RAPID MODULE ISOLATION: Close hatches sequentially towards the designated vehicle Safe Haven / return spacecraft. Verify positive seal.

q_slow_leak.text: Is there a slow atmospheric pressure drift (< 0.2 psi/hr) without an active acoustic alarm?

i_slow_eval.text: SLOW LEAK INVESTIGATION: Check module hatch seals, waste management vacuum vents, and airlock pressure relief valves.

i_nominal_press.text: ATMOSPHERE NOMINAL: Check cabin barometric pressure sensors against ECLSS telemetry. Calibrate sensor array.

end_monitor.text: Cabin pressure within safe operating parameters. Continue automated ECLSS pressure logging.

end_escalate.text: CRITICAL DEPRESSURIZATION EMERGENCY: Flight controllers and Mission Control alerted. Safe Haven protocols active.
